headline: On last trading day, Sensex jumped nearly 900 points while Nifty topped 22,500 in a strong relief rally.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 12 October.

why: A relief rally snapped the Indian stock market's longest weekly losing streak in 25 years.
All sectoral indices turned green during Friday's trading session.
Strong gains in IT and FMCG sectors helped propel the main indices higher.
Market sentiment bounced back following heavy losses recorded in the prior session.
whatHappening: BSE Sensex surged over 870 points to settle above 71,500 levels.
Nifty 50 climbed back above the 22,500 mark with broad-based buying.
SEBI Chairman announced that guidelines on CAS will be issued within a week.
FM Sitharaman met global investment fund executives to discuss investment opportunities in India.
summary: On the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices staged a sharp recovery with Sensex jumping nearly 900 points and Nifty closing above 22,500. All sectoral indices ended in the green, led by IT and FMCG gains, snapping a major weekly losing streak. Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 12 October.
